stated in our approved legal documents is the final position (recorded
2026-08-19). Ratified 2026-08-20 under the owner's coverage-gap tasking

PRESENCE Requirement: it verifies the provision EXISTS. The clause's CONTENT goes to Legal with the evidence — categorical value comparison is a V2 evaluator (CLAUSE_CATALOGUE.md).

The clause is entirely one-directional: the Customer indemnifies LeapSwitch, not the reverse. Presence only — DIRECTION and scope are content, and go to Legal with the evidence rather than being compared here.

_legal_rule_note: APPROVED ZERO-TOLERANCE LEGAL RULE (manager ruling 2026-08-19; owner
approval to wire, 2026-08-20). MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE (no decision needed);
ANY deviation -- an absent provision included -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal
Decision required; nothing that differs is ever auto-approved. There are
deliberately NO thresholds and NO tolerance bands: do not add
acceptable_max or approval_required_above, and do not ask for them --
the policy is that none exists. Wired as deviation_outcome +
unlimited_outcome, both read by the evaluators; an unrecognised value
fails closed to NOT_APPLICABLE and a human (ENG-09, Step 20 r4).
